infoPlist.NSCalendarsUsageDescription: Silo adds an event only when you tap Schedule on something you saved, and reads your day so it can suggest times you're actually free.
infoPlist.NSCalendarsFullAccessUsageDescription: Silo adds an event only when you tap Schedule on something you saved, and reads your day so it can suggest times you're actually free.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Silo reads the screenshots you pick so it can title, tag and file them for you. Your photos are processed on this device and are never uploaded.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Silo uses the camera when you take a photo to save into your library.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Silo uses your location to surface saved places that are near you right now, and to fire the location triggers you set. Your location stays on this device.
